resumeVersions.label: v2 · Generalist
resumeVersions.text:
Ayesha Rahman
ayesha@example.test · London
SUMMARY
Software engineer with experience across web and backend.
EXPERIENCE
Northwind · Backend Engineer · 2019–2025
• Worked on billing services.
• Used PostgreSQL.
• Supported production services.
• Designed REST API contracts for 14 services.
• Automated testing and continuous integration for billing services.
• Used Git for code reviews and collaborative delivery.
• Led system design reviews and wrote architecture documentation.
• Led 9 incident reviews and security reviews for payment services.
EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science
LEADERSHIP
• Helped new team members.
PROJECTS
• Built Docker containers and Kubernetes deployments for a ledger service.

Ayesha Rahman
ayesha@example.test · London
SUMMARY
Backend engineer building payment systems in Go.
EXPERIENCE
Northwind · Backend Engineer · 2019–2025
• Moved billing to Go services, building distributed systems; cut infrastructure cost 22%.
• Sharded Postgres to 4 TB, p95 latency down 38%.
• Supported production services.
• Designed REST API contracts for 14 services.
• Automated testing and continuous integration for billing services.
• Used Git for code reviews and collaborative delivery.
• Led system design reviews and wrote architecture documentation.
• Led 9 incident reviews and security reviews for payment services.
EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science
LEADERSHIP
• Mentored 4 engineers through promotion.
PROJECTS
• Built Docker containers and Kubernetes deployments for a ledger service.
